The Physalis plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation and alleviate symptoms of anxiety and depression. The therapeutic actions of the Physalis plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides. The health benefits of the Physalis plant are also attributed to its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, which may help to protect against cell damage and promote overall well-being.
